Class AeshBackend

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.terminal.AbstractBackend
dev.tamboui.backend.aesh.AeshBackend
All Implemented Interfaces:
Backend, AutoCloseable
public class AeshBackend extends AbstractBackend
Aesh Readline based backend for terminal operations.

This backend uses the aesh-readline library's TerminalConnection abstraction for terminal I/O operations.

Two construction modes are supported:

  • AeshBackend() — creates and owns a system terminal connection; close() will close it.
  • AeshBackend(Connection) — uses an externally provided connection (e.g., from SSH or HTTP); the caller retains ownership and close() will not close the connection.

  • Constructor Details

    • AeshBackend

      public AeshBackend() throws IOException
      Creates a new Aesh backend using a default TerminalConnection.

      The backend owns the connection and will close it when close() is called.

      Throws:
      IOException - if the terminal cannot be initialized

    • AeshBackend

      public AeshBackend(org.aesh.terminal.Connection connection) throws IOException
      Creates a new Aesh backend using the provided Connection.

      This constructor allows creating backends from SSH or HTTP connections. The caller retains ownership of the connection; it will not be closed when this backend is closed.

      Parameters:
      connection - the connection to use for terminal I/O
      Throws:
      IOException - if the terminal cannot be initialized

    • close

      public void close() throws IOException
      Closes this backend, resetting terminal state (mouse capture, alternate screen, cursor visibility, raw mode).

      If this backend owns the connection (created via AeshBackend()), the connection is closed. If an external connection was provided via AeshBackend(Connection), it is left open for the caller to manage.

      Throws:
      IOException - if closing fails
